name: Sadie-Lynn Kobayashi
source:
A student who transferred to Tina Koya during the middle of the previous year. She was part of the cheer team at her previous school, and joined Tina Koya's team immediately after transferring. Due to her cute looks and position on the cheer team, she quickly became part of the school's popular clique.

[In game description]
